name: Brotkäppchen Frühstückscafé
kurzbeschreibung:
**Fairytale Breakfast Café in Hall in Tirol** --- **

Welcome to our cozy breakfast café in the heart of Hall in Tirol!

** At **Brotkäppchen Frühstückscafé**, we invite you to start your day with a warm, homemade breakfast in a charming atmosphere. Whether you're a local or a visitor exploring the beautiful **Tirol**, our café is the perfect place to enjoy a leisurely morning. --- **

Our Highlights

** - **Freshly baked bread** – Enjoy our daily selection of artisanal breads, from crispy **Tiroler Bauernbrot** to delicate **Zopf**. - **Tiroler classics** – Savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Apfelstrudel**, or a hearty **Speckbrot** with local cheese. - **Coffee & tea** – Indulge in a rich **Einspänner** or a soothing **Kräutertee**, brewed to perfection. - **Sweet treats** – End your meal with a slice of our famous **Sachertorte** or a creamy **Topfenstrudel**. --- **

Visit Us

** 📍 **Brotkäppchen Frühstückscafé** 📍 **Hauptplatz 12, 6060 Hall in Tirol** 🕒 **Open daily from 7:00 AM – 2:00 PM** 📞 **Reservations welcome!** --- **

Discover Hall in Tirol

** Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, Hall in Tirol offers a mix of history, nature, and culture. Stroll through the old town, visit the **St. Nikolaus Church**, or take a scenic hike in the surrounding **Kitzbühel Alps**. After your breakfast, explore the charming shops and cafés along the **Inn River**. --- **

Come for breakfast, stay for the memories!

**
